library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(here)
library(viridis)

setup

module = "beige_vs_white"
method_name = "fastmnn"
dataname = paste0("tss_",method_name)
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "tss_fastmnn_monocle_plots_10x"
i_am(file.path("analysis", module, paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
## here() starts at /projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/sc_rnaseq/progenitor_scrnaseq
odir = here("output", module, dataname) 
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("analysis", module, "figures", paste0(rmd_filename))
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))

if (!dir.exists(odir)) dir.create(odir, recursive = TRUE)
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal_white = c("#B3B3B3","#85C2EA","#1F78B4")
names(pal_white) = c("day0","day1","day3")
prog_cols = c("#DA1819","#691A93","#EBB400" , "#434D51","#00AED1","#3AAD00","#FF7F00")
prog_levels = c("p5","p4","p6","p3","p0","p1","p2")
names(prog_cols) = paste0("p", 0:(length(prog_levels)-1))
clusters = tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(12)
names(clusters) = 0:11
cluster_levels= as.character( c(7,1,11,10,3,8,9,0,5,6,2,4))
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = 'Spectral'))

load pseudotime from subsets

dir_list = grep("/subset_", list.dirs(odir), value=T) # 12 subsets with random numbers
pscond_list = c("white", "beige")

# Setup lists to populate
white_list = list()
beige_list = list()

for (subset_dir in dir_list){
    subset_no = gsub(".*/subset_", "", subset_dir)
    
    # Read white data
    white_data = read.delim(file.path(subset_dir, "white_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
    white_data = white_data %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
        mutate(subset_no = subset_no) %>%
        select(cell_id, pscondition, subset_no, raw_pseudotime, monocle_pseudotime)
    white_list[[subset_no]] = white_data
    
    # Read beige data
    beige_data = read.delim(file.path(subset_dir, "beige_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
    beige_data = beige_data %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
        mutate(subset_no = subset_no) %>%
        select(cell_id, pscondition, subset_no, raw_pseudotime, monocle_pseudotime)
    beige_list[[subset_no]] = beige_data
}

# Combine all subsets into final tibbles
white_meta = bind_rows(white_list)
beige_meta = bind_rows(beige_list)
head(white_meta)

load seurat

if (subset_data){
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
  Idents(sbs) = "seurat_clusters"
} else {
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir,"complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(sbs) = "RNA"
}
sbs

##  1 other assay present: mnn.reconstructed

Violin plot clusters

ggplot(merge_mc, 
       aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, y=initial_clusters, fill=initial_clusters)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width") + 
    geom_beeswarm(stat='summary', fun="mean", aes(group=subset_no), cex = 1.5)+
    scale_fill_manual(values=clusters) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cluster_levels)) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) + 
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)

mean_per_cluster = group_by(merge_mc, subset_no, initial_clusters, pscondition) %>% 
    summarise(mean_pseudotime= mean(monocle_pseudotime))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'subset_no', 'initial_clusters'. You can
## override using the `.groups` argument.
head(mean_per_cluster)

## 3 72659     1                beige                 0.116
## 4 72659     1                white                 0.120
## 5 72659     2                beige                 0.817
## 6 72659     2                white                 0.797
ggplot(mean_per_cluster, aes(y=initial_clusters, fill=initial_clusters))+
       geom_boxplot( aes(x=mean_pseudotime))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=clusters) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cluster_levels)) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) +
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)

ggplot(mean_per_cluster, aes(y=initial_clusters, fill=initial_clusters, x=mean_pseudotime))+

    scale_fill_manual(values=clusters) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cluster_levels)) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) +
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)

Ideal plot

  1. load full pseudotime
  2. plot means per progen.cluster derived from downsampling
meta= read.delim(here(odir, "monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
meta$time.progen_clusters = factor(meta$time.progen_clusters )
meta$initial_clusters = factor(meta$initial_clusters, levels = c(0:11))
meta$cond.time = factor(meta$cond.time, levels=c("white.day3","white.day1","asc.day0","beige.day1","beige.day3"))
table(meta$initial_clusters)

Colour violins

mean_per_cluster$cluster.pscond = paste(mean_per_cluster$initial_clusters, sep=".",mean_per_cluster$pscondition)
ggplot(mean_per_cluster, aes(y=initial_clusters, fill=pscondition, x=mean_pseudotime))+
    geom_violin(data=meta, aes(x=monocle_pseudotime),scale="width") + 
    geom_boxplot(fill="transparent",colour="black", position=position_dodge(0.9),
                 aes(group=cluster.pscond)) +
     scale_fill_manual(values=c("#FF7F00","#1F78B4"), name="Pseudotime\ncalculated on",
                       guide=guide_legend(reverse=T)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cluster_levels),
                                                 label=function(x)paste0("t",x)) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL, y="TSS clusters") 

ggsave(here(fig_dir, "wvb_violin_with_variance.png"), width = 9, height = 8)

colour boxplots

meta$cluster.pscond = paste(meta$initial_clusters, sep=".",meta$pscondition)
ggplot(mean_per_cluster, aes(y=initial_clusters, fill=pscondition, x=mean_pseudotime))+
    geom_violin(data=meta, aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, group=cluster.pscond),
                scale="width", fill="grey50",colour="grey50", ) + 
    geom_boxplot(colour="black", alpha=0.5, outlier.fill="black", outlier.alpha=1) +
    geom_text(data=data.frame(),aes(x=0.125, y="4", label="End"), inherit.aes = F)+
     scale_fill_manual(values=c("#FF7F00","#1F78B4"), name="Pseudotime\ncalculated on",
                       guide=guide_legend(reverse=T)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + 
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cluster_levels), labels=function(x)paste0("t",x)) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL, y="TSS clusters")
